arguments.sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(player_api_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM main.Player) AS duplicate_player_api_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Player WHERE typeof(height) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null')) AS nonnumeric_heights,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Player_Attributes WHERE typeof(heading_accuracy) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null')) AS nonnumeric_heading_scores,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Player_Attributes WHERE heading_accuracy IS NULL) AS missing_heading_scores,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Player_Attributes WHERE heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL) AS recorded_heading_scores,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Player_Attributes AS a JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_api_id WHERE a.heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL) AS matched_heading_scores

arguments.sql:
SELECT p.player_name
FROM main.Player AS p
JOIN main.Player_Attributes AS a
    ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
    AND a.heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(a.heading_accuracy) DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10
